video.title: The Top 9 Fantasy Basketball Players On New Teams For 2026/27

summary: Josh Lloyd looks at the best fantasy players who changed teams in 2026 NBA free agency. He counts nine players from the top 56 of last season who moved, plus about 11 more from the top 120. He expects a chaotic season because of all the movement, players returning from injury, and the new lottery rules (the 3-2-1 system and a relegation zone). Teams with no reason to tank, like Brooklyn and Milwaukee, are the ones to watch. His main calls: Kawhi Leonard is fine as a pick in the 40s but not in rounds one or two, and Giannis Antetokounmpo could climb back toward top five in Miami. He thinks Walker Kessler could be a top 20 player with the Lakers, Jaylen Brown will lose value in Philadelphia, and LaMelo Ball should play more minutes in Minnesota. He sees good spots for Julius Randle in Brooklyn and Paul George in Boston. Tyler Herro is in a crowded Bucks backcourt, and most of the lower-ranked movers have little draft value. Naz Reid and Kel'el Ware are the exceptions, as likely top 50 picks.
